1.d4 f5 2.g3 c6 3.Bg2 g6 4.Nf3 Bg7 5.O-O.strategy: Gets the king to safety behind the g2 bishop and brings the rook towards the centre. It finishes the kingside development and leaves White free to choose a plan in the centre.
Develops the knight to the rim, which keeps f6 free for the g7 bishop's diagonal. The price is a knight far from the centre that White's c1 bishop already attacks, so White can trade it off at once.
1.d4 f5 2.g3 c6 3.Bg2 g6 4.Nf3 Bg7 5.O-O.name: Dutch Defence: Leningrad, Basman System
